blocks.title: USB Charging Only (ADB)
blocks.body:
# Set USB Mode to Charging Only (ADB)

## Quick visual

![USB port modes](/media/diagrams/usb-modes.svg)

Charging-only mode reduces data exposure on kiosk tablets. Use ADB while debugging is still available, then lock the policy.

Restrict the USB port to charging only and disable data transfer.

## Steps
1. Enable Developer Options and USB Debugging.
2. Connect the device with USB.

### Set charging only
```
adb shell settings put global usb_default_function none
```

### Verify
```
adb shell settings get global usb_default_function
```
Expected result: `none`

### Restore other modes
- MTP: `adb shell settings put global usb_default_function mtp`
- PTP: `adb shell settings put global usb_default_function ptp`
- ADB: `adb shell settings put global usb_default_function adb`

## Notes
Behavior may vary by OEM and Android version. After charging-only mode, ADB over USB is disabled until USB mode is restored.
